title: Dojo extension file
description: An extensions/*.json file: one extension's metadata plus its source(s). Mirrors lib/src/extension_models.dart (the authoritative model) and docs/extensions.md (the prose walkthrough). x-engineVersion is the koni_dojo package version (see pubspec.yaml) this schema was last verified against — bump both together whenever the schema's shape changes; test/schema_sync_test.dart checks this file's properties against every config class's actual toJson() field set, so a Dart-side field with no matching schema entry (or vice versa) fails the test suite instead of silently shipping.

version.description: Not hand-authored semver — an opaque content identifier (a truncated SHA-256 of the curated file's raw bytes) stamped in by tool/build_repo.dart at build time. Carries no ordering; an app's update check is a plain inequality against the installed copy, never "is this greater than".

updatedAt.description: The curated file's last-changed date (YYYY-MM-DD, from git log), stamped in alongside version by tool/build_repo.dart — a human-readable companion to it, not a second source of truth. version is what actually answers "is this different"; this is best-effort decoration for "updated {date}" UI copy. Never hand-authored.

nsfw.description: 0/1 (or a bool) — whether the extension is 18+.

source.description: One source, discriminated by `type`: absent/anything else is the HTML dialect (sourceConfig); "api" is the JSON-API dialect (apiSourceConfig).

icon.description: A data:image/png;base64,… URI (inlined by tool/build_repo.dart from extensions/icons/) or an http(s) URL. Not usually hand-authored.

webview.description: Route this source's page GETs through the app's WebView (real browser fingerprint + Cloudflare clearance) instead of the HTTP client — for hosts whose Cloudflare mode re-challenges cookie-replay from a non-browser client.

warmImageByUrl.description: For a webview source: when warming a cover/page image's origin before fetching its bytes, navigate to the image's own URL instead of its bare origin. Default (false) is what most sites need. A handful of CDN-only hosts (no real page at "/") WAF-block a bare root-path request outright while serving the actual asset path with no challenge at all, and need this set to true.

warmImageViaImgTag.description: For a webview source: fetch cover/page image bytes by navigating to (or reusing) a page at this source's own baseUrl, then injecting a same-page for the image URL and reading it back via canvas — instead of warmImageByUrl's direct navigation to the image's own URL/origin. Recovers two failures warmImageByUrl can't: a WAF whose Referer check wants the site's own origin specifically (not the image host's), or a CDN that mislabels real image bytes with a non-image Content-Type (breaking the browser's own image-document rendering that warmImageByUrl's canvas extraction depends on). Needs the CDN's Access-Control-Allow-Origin to permit the canvas read. Takes precedence over warmImageByUrl when both are set.

js.description: Opt-in to running `js` pipeline steps (sandboxed QuickJS) — required by any config using a `js` step; tool/build_repo.dart enforces it.

loginUrl.description: Absolute URL of this source's own login page — gates whether the app offers a "log in" action for it; absent means no login concept. Purely a UI trigger for the app's WebView-based login capture; the engine never fetches this URL or knows what "logged in" means. Meaningful only alongside webview: true.

localStorageSeed.description: For a webview source: key -> JSON value entries to seed into the WebView's localStorage for this source's origin, once per process, before the first real fetch there — for a purely client-side gate (an age/content-warning interstitial) that blocks real content but isn't session state.

localStoragePreferences.description: User-facing consent toggles that patch localStorageSeed at fetch time, for a preference that shouldn't be forced the same way for everyone.

id.description: Stable identifier — the key a LocalStoragePreferenceStore stores this toggle's override under.

label.description: User-facing label for this toggle's control.

seedKey.description: Top-level key within localStorageSeed this toggle writes into.

path.description: Path of nested keys under seedKey to the boolean this toggle writes.

tag.description: Exact-match browse for one or more already-known tag values (e.g. a value out of details.genres) — its own precise listing endpoint, distinct from search's free-text relevance ranking. For sites whose tags are too numerous to enumerate as filter options (one per model/publisher, not a small curated taxonomy). tagParam/tagExcludeParam declare multi-tag/exclusion support; unset means the source only browses one tag at a time via {query} in path.

apiUrl.description: Root the listing/details/chapters/pages paths resolve against.

imageHeaders.description: Headers for fetching covers and pages; API CDNs usually need none.

tag.description: Exact-match browse for one or more already-known tag values — same idea as the HTML dialect's tag listing, using apiListing's tagParam/tagExcludeParam/tagJoin.

valueRewrite.description: find replaces literally; pattern is a regex whose replacement may reference groups as $1..$9. find wins when both are given.

coverChain.description: Multi-step cover extraction; the first step yielding a non-empty value (after its rewrite) wins.

requestTransform.description: Derives the URL actually fetched from the stored one: an optional regex rewrite, then an optional literal suffix. Or an explicit url/method/body/headers request (optionally two-phase via idSelector/idAttr).

label.description: Rows whose label contains any of these (case-insensitive) contribute every valueSelector match.

rows.description:
Declarative extraction of
  • Label: value
    • -style metadata rows.

fields.description: Keyed by the manga field to fill: author, status, genres or description.

optionsFrom.description: Discovers a filter group's option list from the source at runtime; the static options[] then serve as a fallback.

filter.description: A declarative search filter group: the user's selected options are appended to the search listing's URL as query parameters.

join.description: '' repeats the parameter (?g=a&g=b); any other string joins values into one (?g=a,b).

path.description: {page}, {offset} (= (page-1)*pageSize) and {query} are substituted. Empty only when steps supplies the extraction. For tag, {query} substitutes the first included value and is path-segment escaped (spaces as %20) rather than query-string escaped (spaces as +), since a tag value there typically sits in the URL path itself.

pageSize.description: Items per page, used only to compute {offset}.

queryMap.description: Case-insensitive exact-match rewrite of the raw query, checked before queryReplace — for a fixed vocabulary (e.g. a tag/genre label) whose site-side browse value doesn't derive from its display text by any rule. A query that isn't a key falls through unchanged.

tagParam.description: Meaningful only on tag: query parameter carrying every included tag value (not just the extras beyond the first). Unset means the source can only browse one tag at a time via {query} in path — TagCapabilities.multiple is derived from this being set, not hand-declared.

tagExcludeParam.description: Meaningful only on tag: query parameter carrying excluded tag values. Unset means the source can't exclude a tag — TagCapabilities.exclusion is derived from this being set.

tagJoin.description: How tagParam/tagExcludeParam serialize multiple values: unset repeats the parameter (?tag=a&tag=b), any other string joins them into one value (?tag=a,b).

bannerSelector.description: A wide hero image distinct from cover (a poster-shaped thumbnail) and background (a tiled backdrop meant to sit beneath it) — some sites render all three.

backgroundSelector.description: A tiled backdrop distinct from banner — often a near-solid per-series mood color rather than character art, so typically a cleaner tint-color source than banner. A CSS background-image URL doesn't live in a plain src/href attribute: use attr:"style" plus a chain rewrite (pattern/replace with $1 group refs) to pull the URL out of the raw url('...') value.

genreSelector.description: Every matching element contributes one genre (its text, or genreAttr when set) — no label required, unlike rows. Overridden by rows' own genres field when that's also configured and matches.

unlistedChaptersSelector.description: A count the site advertises but doesn't expose through chapters at all (e.g. "Read 12 new episodes only on the app!") — distinct from chapters.lockedSelector, which flags a chapter that IS listed. The matched text is parsed leniently: the first run of digits found. Absent/unmatched/unparseable all mean 0.

statusMap.description: Maps the site's status text (case-insensitive) to ongoing/completed/hiatus/cancelled.

request.description: Derives the chapter-list URL from the manga URL; absent fetches the manga URL itself.

lockedSelector.description: Checked for presence (not text/attribute) within the chapter item — a match flags the chapter as locked (paywalled).

officialSelector.description: Locates an element (with officialAttr/officialValue) within the chapter item whose extracted value marks this chapter as an official (licensed) translation rather than a fan scanlation. Unlike lockedSelector this is a value check, not presence — needed when the same badge element renders for every chapter and only an attribute differs.

officialAttr.description: Attribute officialSelector's element is read from; empty reads its text.

officialValue.description: Substring officialSelector's extracted value must contain for the chapter to be flagged official. Empty means the source has no such concept.

reversed.description: True when the site lists newest chapters first (the common case); the engine then reverses into reading order.

scriptPages.description: Extracts page image URLs from an inline

pattern.description: First capture group must yield the JSON text.

itemsPath.description: Empty = the captured JSON is itself the list.

request.description: Derives the page-list URL from the chapter URL; absent fetches the chapter URL itself.

jsonValueSpec.description: Extraction of one string value from a JSON node: the first non-empty paths hit, optionally rendered through template ({value} = the hit). A bare string is shorthand for a single path.

jsonNameSpec.description: A multi-part label (e.g. "Vol. 1 Ch. 2 Title"): each part is a jsonValueSpec, missing parts skipped, the rest joined.

items.description: JSON path to the result array.

totalPath.description: JSON path to a total count for has-next; falls back to "page was full" when absent.

item.description: JSON path to the manga node in the response.

skipIf.description: Items with a non-null value at this path are dropped (e.g. a chapter that's actually hosted externally, outside this source).

locked.description: Path to a value indicating this chapter is paywalled, read "truthy" (non-null/zero/false/empty).

official.description: Path to a value indicating this chapter is an official (licensed) translation rather than a fan scanlation, read "truthy" the same way locked is.

pipeline.title: Explicit step pipeline (steps:)
pipeline.description: Overrides an operation's sugar fields with an ordered list of steps threading captured variables forward. See docs/extensions.md § Explicit step pipelines and docs/source-pipeline-engine.md.

locator.description: Extraction of one value from a parsed response. Under parse:html, selector+attr (empty attr = element text, empty selector = the root); under parse:json/regexJson, path+template ({value} = the located node). regex (optionally against `from`, a threaded var, instead of the body) takes precedence over selector/path when set.

regex.description: First capture group is the value.

from.description: Match `regex` against this threaded var instead of the response body.

imageFallback.description: Falls back to the data-src attribute (lazy-load images).

values.description: On a list locator: iterate a JSON object's values (object-keyed collections).

encode.description: URL-encode the captured value before threading it into a later request.

fallbacks.description: Tried in order when this locator yields nothing; the first non-empty wins.

pagination.description: For a record or flat-list output whose source paginates server-side: re-runs the step, incrementing pageVar, merging results, until currentPageMeta/lastPageMeta or hasNextMeta (read from `yield.meta`) agree there's nothing left or maxPages is hit.

hasNextMeta.description: Alternative to currentPageMeta/lastPageMeta for a paginator that only exposes a has-next-page presence signal (e.g. a `rel=next` link) rather than a reliable total page count. Takes priority over currentPageMeta/lastPageMeta when set.

stepOutput.description: The terminal step's result producer: a record list (list+fields+meta) for listings/chapters, a flat list (list+value) for pages, or a generate shape (count+value.template+start) for readers with a page count and a {n}-templated URL.

meta.description: Document/root-level values read once from the terminal response (e.g. a has-next flag).

url.description: Templated over the threaded vars ({var}); relative resolves against baseUrl/apiUrl.

jsStep.description: A compute step: run `code` in the sandboxed JS runtime instead of fetching. Requires the source's top-level `js: true`.

args.description: {var} templates resolved from threaded vars, JSON-injected as the global $.

capture.description: Var name to store the string result in.

captureJson.description: When the result is a JSON object: {var: path} pairs to capture by path.

decryptStep.description: A compute step: decrypt an already-captured {ct,iv,s} ciphertext envelope (CryptoJS passphrase-mode AES-256-CBC, OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey/MD5 key derivation, explicit IV — a shape a few sites' "protect the page list" schemes ship) instead of fetching. See lib/src/crypto_decrypt.dart and the jinmangas writeup in sources-catalog.md.

data.description: {var} template resolving to the {ct,iv,s} JSON envelope.

capture.description: Var name for the plaintext, on an intermediate step.

step.title: Step
step.description: One hop of a pipeline: fetch (request) or compute (js/decrypt), parse (parse/regex), then either capture scalars for later steps or yield the operation's result (terminal step only).

regex.description: For parse:regexJson: first capture group is the JSON text.

htmlFrom.description: For parse:jsonHtml: JSON path to the HTML fragment string.

capture.description: Scalars threaded into later steps as {name}.

yield.description: Present on the terminal step only — produces the operation's result.
